# rc-paywall-lab-for-agents
> Author, preview (iOS simulator + Android emulator, offline, both intro-offer eligibility states), lint, diff, push and publish RevenueCat Paywalls v2 (components JSON) via the REST API v2 — designed to be operated by a coding agent.

- Start here for agents: AGENTS.md
- Human overview + 60-second start: README.md
- CLI: lab.py (`python3 lab.py -h`); DSL: paywall_dsl.py; lint rules: lab_lint.py
- Field guide for the JSON: docs/PAYWALL_JSON.md
- Why the dashboard builder isn't enough: docs/revenuecat-builder-gaps.md
- Platforms/toolchains/SDK pins: docs/platforms.md
- Workflow & publish policy: docs/workflow.md
- Contribute by prompt, not PR: CONTRIBUTING.md
